yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-clie.description: Use this to match your tone to the buyer type. Six types. Same deal, different music.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-cold.description: Use this for first messages to strangers. DMs, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-dark.description: Use this to spot manipulation aimed at you. And to keep your own moves on the honest side.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-deal.description: Use this as the always-on brain. Read the last message, find the first match, act. Ten seconds.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-disc.description: Use this to find out what someone wants, fears, or hides. Without interrogating them.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-fram.description: Use this when you feel needy, the other side tests you, or you are losing control of the talk.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-obje.description: Use this when someone pushes back. Price, trust, timing, rivals, guarantees, silence.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-oper.description: Use this before you send anything important, and after every rejection.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-pric.description: Use this when price comes up. Set the first number. Hold it. Move in structure, never in discounts.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-read.description: Use this to read true intent in chat. Who is real, who is shopping, who runs a trick on you.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-risk.description: Use this to close hesitant buyers. Move the risk from them to you. The strongest close in low-trust markets.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-trus.description: Use this when a stranger has no reason to believe you. Builds trust with structure instead of big claims.

yanniskiefer-dark-psychology-skills-walk.description: Use this when terms are impossible, the buyer turns rude, or the thread is dead.
